_readme: Every function this project GRANTs EXECUTE on to `anon` or `authenticated` must
appear here exactly once. A new RPC that is not listed FAILS the build, which is
the whole point: the previous design was a hardcoded JS Set inside
check-rpc-authz.mjs, so a new RPC shipped unguarded by DEFAULT and only a
reviewer noticing could stop it. Now silence is a failure rather than a pass.
Guests sign in anonymously, which makes them `authenticated` — the SAME
PostgREST role staff hold. So for a SECURITY DEFINER function the only thing
between a cafe guest and a privileged body is the guard on its first line.
publicByDesign — a guest may call this. Adding a name here is a security
decision and needs the reason written next to it.
guarded — must refuse an anonymous guest. check-rpc-authz.mjs PROVES this by
calling every one of them as a real guest; it is not taken on trust.
Baseline 2026-09-04: 19 public, 108 guarded, 60 of 127 covered by tests/rls-matrix.ts.
